title: Scale, Cache Sharding & Layout Compression
highlights: Bounded Scale Path: Parallel worker-thread graph construction scales deterministic 100,000-file fixtures to 55.0s cold and 44.4s warm builds.
Atomic Sharded Caching: Checksum-protected sharded incremental caching provides ultra-fast 57ms scoped rebuilds.
Workspace Federation: Deep workspace understanding, cross-package boundary mapping, package-local Agent entrypoints, and package-scoped MCP queries.
Safe Layout Compression: 'tokencap compress' safely shrinks snapshot markdown files by redacting whitespace/comments while preserving code blocks byte-exact.
Infrastructure Dependency Mapping: Adds infrastructure graph nodes for Docker Compose files and local Terraform modules.
Resource Control: Implements configurable memory ceilings to prevent out-of-memory errors on massive scale repositories.

title: AST-Derived Symbol Graph, Frontend Intelligence & Impact Analysis
highlights: AST Parsing via Web-Tree-Sitter: Precision parsing for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX/TSX, and Python (Tier 1), and Go, Rust, and Java symbols (Tier 2), with vendored WASM grammars and no build steps.
Symbol Graph & Call Resolution: Builds a granular symbol-level code graph with resolved call edges, achieving 88% call resolution accuracy on benchmarks.

Blast Radius & Impact Analysis: New 'tokencap impact <file>:<symbol>' command showing direct/transitive callers, files touched, boundary crossings, risk level, and frontend props/rendered-by connections.
Dead-Code Detection: Identify uncalled, non-exported code across the repository with 'tokencap impact --dead-code'.
Frontend Intelligence: Extends analysis to component graphs, props flow, route mapping, state ownership, test IDs, accessibility roles, and design tokens.
Architecture Decision Records: Persist ADRs across sessions using the new 'tokencap_manage_adr' MCP tool.
Incremental Cache Guard: Bumped cache version to 1.8.0, forcing full rebuilds from legacy cache formats to prevent corruption.
Execution Contract Guardrails: Enforces dependency minimalism (strictly <=4 runtime dependencies) and packing constraints (<10MB size).

title: Host Plugins, Refactored CLI Subcommands & VS Code Intelligence
highlights: Official Plugin Ecosystem: Host plugins for Claude Code (tokencap) and OpenAI Codex (tokencap-context) hosted at https://github.com/vansharora21/tokencap-plugin.git.
Restructured CLI Hierarchy: Clean subcommand grouping: tokencap make, tokencap ask, tokencap ask brain, tokencap analyze diff, tokencap security scan, tokencap security audit.
VS Code Extension Auto-Capture: Native VS Code status bar quick-picks, automatic save triggers, and debounced snapshot refreshing.
Auto-Inferred Notes & Debug: Automatically infers .tokencap-notes.md and .tokencap-debug.md when missing from git commit history and source structure.
CI-Enforced Local-Only Security: Zero network calls, centralized secret redaction, and local stdio MCP communication.

title: Token Savings Engine, Multi-Host Pointers & Verified Benchmarks
highlights: Token & Dollar Savings Engine: Real-time savings calculation and persistent before-and-after reporting (.tokencap/savings.json).
12.2× Token Reduction Benchmark: Verified 94.3% cost reduction across 15 real-world repository tasks with exact tiktoken counting.
Multi-Host Agent Pointers: Auto-generates non-overwriting pointer files for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Copilot, and Kiro.
CI-Enforced Zero Egress: Guaranteed offline security verified across source files on every commit with zero telemetry.
Centralized Secret Redaction: Entropy and regex secret scanning to redact API keys, tokens, and PEM blocks into [REDACTED:*] markers.

title: Self-Maintaining MCP Intelligence
highlights: Automatic Initialization: MCP startup automatically runs tokencap make before tool execution, eliminating manual builds.
Live Repository Watcher: MCP server runs a background watcher for source files and .tokencap-notes.md updates.
Universal Host Setup: tokencap mcp --init supports Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, VS Code, Antigravity, and Codex.
Explicit Client Selector: Use tokencap mcp --init --client <host> when workspaces contain multiple AI clients.
Safer Configuration: Merges TokenCap server into existing valid JSON or TOML configs without overwriting unrelated servers.
Faster Build Sharing: Shares pre-resolved graph context between agent and brain builders.
Durable Metadata: Stores detected tech stack in knowledge.json for offline MCP overview rendering.

title: Repository Intelligence Service & Security Hardening
highlights: Repository Intelligence Service: Query repository intelligence live over local stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP).

11 Tool Endpoints: Exposes tokencap_overview, tokencap_files, tokencap_search, tokencap_cluster, tokencap_dependencies, tokencap_constitution, tokencap_impact, tokencap_execution, tokencap_verify, tokencap_delta, and tokencap_mcp_status.
Security Hardening Engine: Centralized secret redaction guarantees no API keys, tokens, or private credentials enter intelligence outputs.
Auto IDE Configuration: tokencap mcp --init writes workspace host configs for Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and Antigravity.
Sub-2ms Server Response: In-memory cached tool calls process in 0-2ms handler duration.
Up to 92% Token Budget Savings: Eliminates massive context re-loads by allowing AI models to query targeted intelligence on demand.

title: Incremental Intelligence Engine
highlights: Incremental Intelligence Engine: Analyze once. Update only what changed. Sub-100ms updates for single-file edits.
Hash Cache: SHA-256 hash comparison against .tokencap/cache/hashes.cache.json.
Bidirectional Dependency Walk: Forward walk (consumers) and backward walk (providers) of changed files.
Delta Files: Writes .tokencap/delta/ files (changed-files.json, affected-clusters.json, etc.) and versioned history.
Zero-Change Scenario: Sub-second. No disk writes. No rebuilding if nothing changed.
New CLI Flags: tokencap make (incremental by default), --full (force full rebuild), --rebuild-brain, --rebuild-constitution, --rebuild-graph, --clean-cache.

title: Repository Constitution
highlights: Repository Constitution: Introduces tokencap constitution and tokencap make integration to generate permanent laws that AI coding agents must never violate.
Inferred Law Sheets: Compiles api-contracts.yaml, schema-invariants.yaml, architecture-laws.md, security-boundaries.md, compliance-rules.md, and critical-flows.md under .tokencap/constitution/.
Single Source of Truth: Implements ConstitutionGraph internal model, rendering consistent rule lists across JSON, YAML, Markdown, and Interactive HTML UI.
Rule Structure & IDs: Uniquely identifies constraints (e.g. CONST-SEC-001) mapping stable fields: severity (IMMUTABLE, CRITICAL, etc.), confidence rating, failure effects, and file derivations.
Constitution Score: Computes overall health ratings (0-100) across Architecture, API Stability, Schema, Security, and Compliance areas.
Manual Overrides: Support for custom business logic or compliance rules defined inside tokencap.constitution.yaml.
AI Visibility: Automatically injects constitution scores, rules, and severity levels into agent onboarding START_HERE.md and context pack manifests.

title: Execution Contract
highlights: Execution Contract: Introduces tokencap agent --execution to generate a complete Execution Contract lifecycle suite inside .tokencap/agent/execution-contract/.
Scope Drift Detection: Dynamically tracks objective, scope, and drift in real-time, enforcing warnings if the agent expands beyond original limits.
Minimal Solution First: Restricts new code generation until config, existing utilities, components, services, and installed dependencies are checked first.
Confidence Rating: Requires build/test/lint verification reports and assigns a percentage rating before declaring any task 'Fixed'.
Recovery Mode: Provides a structured protocol (hypothesis, previous attempts, unknowns, recommended next step) when stuck in a reasoning loop.
Change Classification: Automatically organizes modifications into Behavior/Architecture/Bug Fix/Refactoring taxonomy with risk assessments.
Advisory vs Strict Mode: Preserve freedom with advisory mode (default) or enforce gate checks and cluster gates with --strict mode.

title: Self-Loading Universal Context Layer
highlights: Self-Loading Universal Context Layer: AI automatically discovers and loads your project intelligence without manual context copying.
tokencap agent Command: Generates a root AGENTS.md file that redirects AI agents directly to the full onboarding suite under .tokencap/agent/START_HERE.md.

Onboarding Suite: Automatically compiles allowed-context.json (topic-to-file-glob mapper), model-instructions.md (custom guidelines per model), and context-manifest.json (machine-readable single source of truth).
--no-agents-file Flag: Prevents the creation of root AGENTS.md if you prefer to keep your repository root clean.
Topic-Based Context Packing: tokencap pack <topic> queries the Brain to boost relevance weights for that specific cluster, generating scoped context packs.
Future IDE Exporters: Built-in support and --export stub for generating IDE-specific rulesets (e.g. windsurf, cursor, cline, roocode) in v1.1.

title: Project Brain
highlights: Project Brain: TokenCap now thinks in clusters, not just files, providing a unified project intelligence view.

tokencap brain <topic> Flagship Command: Ask about any part of your codebase and get a unified intelligence view: files, risk, architecture, dependencies, review groups, recent changes, and git timeline — all from a single command.
Unified Knowledge Base: tokencap make now builds .tokencap/brain/knowledge.json, aggregating all engines (Graph, Diff, Agent, Memory) into a single queryable index.
6 Brain Modes: Renders focused intelligence views via --impact, --architecture, --review, --timeline, --risk, and --deps flags.
Fuzzy Cluster Matching: tokencap brain auth finds the Authentication cluster even if the topic is partially matched.
No-Topic Overview: Running tokencap brain with no arguments lists all clusters with risk levels at a glance.
Brain Index: Builds .tokencap/brain/brain-index.json for fast cluster to file lookup.
Zero Extra Dependencies: Built entirely on top of the existing Graph, Diff, Memory, and Pack engines with no new package requirements.
10-Command CLI suite: Added 'brain' command to the command-line CLI suite, expanding from 9 to 10 commands.

title: Agent Intelligence Engine
highlights: Agent Intelligence Engine: TokenCap evolves from a context generator to an AI Project Intelligence Platform by analyzing your repository and automatically generating a complete Agent Skill Pack.
tokencap agent Flagship Command: Scans your repository and automatically builds detailed instructions teaching an AI agent your architecture, conventions, risk maps, and rules.
8-Phase Pipeline: Sequences analysis from Tech Stack → Architecture → Project Rules → Risk Map → Review Groups → Agent Skills → Agent Pack → Machine-readable JSON.
agent-pack.md Payload: Generates a single, paste-ready markdown file optimized for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, and OpenHands.
agent.json Export: Structured machine-readable format containing system definitions and agentInjectHooks for future automated injection integrations (v0.9+).
Focused Mode Flags: Added --full (default), --architecture, --rules, and --skills to generate focused sub-sections of the intelligence pack.
Zero New Dependencies: Built entirely on top of the existing Graph, Diff, Memory, and Pack engines with no new dependencies.
9-Command CLI suite: Added 'agent' command to the command-line CLI suite, expanding from 8 to 9 commands.

title: Smart Retrieval Engine
highlights: Smart Retrieval Engine: TokenCap transitions from generating full project context snapshots to automatically retrieving only the relevant files matching your questions.

tokencap ask "question" Flagship Command: Ask natural language questions (e.g. "how does auth work?") and TokenCap scans keywords, matches them to graph clusters, ranks files by relevance, performs BFS, and packages the result.
tokencap context <topic> Command: Manually build context package for a specific topic (e.g. payments, dashboard) with AST outlines and token budgets.
Multi-Source Relevance Scoring: Automatically ranks files by combining Graph topology (connectivity), Memory layer (active tasks), Git Diff (recently changed files), and Impact analysis.

Auto-Mode Detection: Questions are scanned to auto-detect the best output format: 'architecture' mode (for overview/structure), 'review' mode (for check/verify/audit), or 'debug' mode (for debug/fix/bug/error).
Graph BFS Traversal: Finds not only matching files but automatically traverses up to 2-hop dependencies and dependents to provide complete contextual imports.
Token-Budgeted Retrieval: Allocates files, structural outlines, or AST summaries dynamically using the pack engine's budget manager (default 12,000 tokens).
Automated Prompt Generation: Generates a tailored, ready-to-use AI prompt file alongside the retrieved context package.
CLI Command Upgrade: Added 'ask' and 'context' CLI commands, expanding TokenCap from 6 to 8 commands.

title: Graph Intelligence & Unified CLI
highlights: Graph Intelligence Upgrade: TokenCap Graph is now a comprehensive code intelligence graph with an Obsidian-style three-panel viewer, hover highlights, local graph mode, cluster filtering, and a right-side node inspector.
13 Node Classification Types: File nodes categorized into route, api, component, controller, service, database, middleware, config, utility, hook, package, test, and unknown.
4-Tier Risk Scoring: Dynamic risk tiers (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) computed per node based on connectivity, type, and git change status.
Graph Presets: Simplifies flag usage with predefined presets: --full (diff + AI + HTML viewer), --minimal (JSON export only), and --quiet (suppress verbose logs).
Automatic Cluster Detection: Groups files into 9 logical domains (Authentication, Payments, Dashboard, Database, API, Frontend, Config, Testing, Utilities).
TOKENCAP.md Graph Summary: Injects a dynamic '## Project Graph Summary' section into your main workspace snapshot file after every graph run.
Simplified 6-Command CLI: Streamlined the CLI interface from 14 to 6 core commands: make, graph, diff, debug, pack, and watch.
Unified Debug Session: Unified all debugging sub-commands into flags under a single command: tokencap debug --start / --end / --log.

title: AI Context Packing & Graph Features
highlights: AI Context Packing (tokencap pack): A token-budgeted, importance-scored context compressor that uses AST analysis and git history to prioritize files under a strict token budget (e.g. 20,000 tokens) using smart truncation (full content, structural outlines, AST summaries, or reference-only).

Multiple Pack Modes: Optimize your pack for specific tasks: --mode review (code review), --mode debug (debugging context), --mode architecture (high-level system structure), or --mode minimal (fastest summary).
Interactive Knowledge Graph Viewer: Run 'tokencap graph --open' to view a self-contained, interactive HTML representation of your file dependency graph, rendered with Cytoscape.js.
Narrative AI Architecture Summary: Run 'tokencap graph --ai' to generate a detailed markdown summary of your subsystems, component breakdown, and module descriptions.
Graph Structural Diffing: Run 'tokencap graph --diff' to see how relationships, files, and modules have changed between runs.
JSON Export: Run 'tokencap graph --json' to export raw node/edge details to .tokencap/graph/ for custom integrations.

title: AI Change Intelligence Engine
highlights: AI Change Intelligence Engine (tokencap diff): Transforms raw code changes into meaningful, AI-readable insights, answering what changed, why it matters, what could break, and what should be tested.

Smart Semantic Classification: Groups changed files into semantic layers (e.g. Authentication, Payment, Database, API, Frontend, Security, Middleware, Config, etc.) to determine the overall risk level.
Breaking Change Detection: Scans diff files for deleted exports, changed function signatures, Prisma field changes, and major dependency bumps.
API Endpoint Mapping: Extracts added/modified/deleted API routes and automatically generates suggested test cases.
Interactive Prompts & Summaries: Generates optimized AI code review prompts and PR summaries to streamline developer handoff (options --pr, --prompt, --json).

title: AI Debug Handoff Mode
highlights: AI Debug Handoff Mode: Session-based debugging memory subsystem that captures runtime environments, command failures, error stack traces, and priority files
Automated CLI Capture: Run 'tokencap debug:start -- <command>' (e.g., npm test) to run a command and automatically capture failed tests, error logs, and stack traces
Investigation Order: Automatically ranks files to investigate using stack traces, suspected files, git changes, and dependency graph neighbors
Session Timeline: Log custom events or progress manually via 'tokencap debug:log "message"' with timestamping
Session History & Archiving: Ended debug sessions are automatically archived to '.tokencap/debug/archive/' instead of being deleted
Five new commands: tokencap debug:start, tokencap debug, tokencap debug:log, tokencap debug:end, and tokencap debug:history
Automatic test runner parser support for Jest, Vitest, Mocha, Node test runner, pytest, and Go test
Auto-created debug templates: '.tokencap-debug.md' in the project root to edit Problem statement, Attempted Fixes, and Unresolved Questions
Highly modularized structure under src/debug/

title: Initial Release
highlights: Auto Capture on Save with configurable debounce
VS Code status bar integration with Quick-Pick command menu
Intelligent file ranking — changed files, source files, and project metadata surfaced first
8 context profiles: compact, balanced, deep, gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet, gemini-1.5-flash, gemini-1.5-pro, llama-3-8b
Git integration: branch, status, staged/unstaged diffs, recent commits
Automatic secret redaction: OpenAI keys, GitHub PATs, Slack tokens, AWS keys, Google API keys
Structural outlines for truncated files
TODO / FIXME / HACK detection across all selected files
Real-time token estimation
CLI: make, watch, init, config commands
.tokencap.json project config with include/exclude glob patterns
Support for 40+ file extensions across all major languages
VSIX extension package for VS Code / Cursor

title: Intelligence Layer
highlights: Project Knowledge Graph: TOKENCAP_GRAPH.md — maps file imports, exports, and requires across all JS/TS source files
Context Memory Layer: TOKENCAP_MEMORY.md — developer context from .tokencap-notes.md combined with Git state
Auto-creates .tokencap-notes.md from a structured template if missing
Node classification: route, api, component, service, database, config, unknown
Import parsing: ES import/export and CommonJS require — local specifiers only
Path resolution with extension guessing (.ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs) and index fallbacks
New CLI commands: tokencap graph and tokencap memory
tokencap make now generates all three files in one command
TOKENCAP.md now includes a TokenCap Intelligence Files reference block
.gitignore updated — TOKENCAP_GRAPH.md, TOKENCAP_MEMORY.md, .tokencap-notes.md excluded from git
VS Code extension: graph and memory generated on every auto-capture cycle
Watcher updated to ignore new generated files and prevent re-trigger loops
All new modules in src/graph/ and src/memory/ — fully modular
